The person has an oval face with moderate, rounded forehead, subtle brow ridge, and medium-density soft-arched eyebrows. The almond-shaped eyes feature horizontal palpebral fissures and visible upper lid creases. The straight-dorsum nose has a rounded tip, and the mouth has defined cupid's bow, full vermilion, and slightly upturned corners.
